Package com.sca4d.iot.device

Class DeviceRepository

java.lang.Object
com.sca4d.iot.device.DeviceRepository
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.sca4d.iot.api.connection.DeviceConnectionResolver
public class DeviceRepository extends Object implements com.sca4d.iot.api.connection.DeviceConnectionResolver
把 Device 持久化状态和接入方式集合转换成完整 Device，并检查写入结果。
